Body.Content:
Azure Lighthouse capabilities, built comprehensively across the Azure platform, enable cross-tenant management of customer estates with greater visibility and control, allowing partners to service more customers, larger workloads, and most mission-critical apps with precision. Azure Lighthouse works consistently across Azure services and licensing models to help streamline managed service operations and protect management IP. As Azure as a platform does more for service providers natively, partners can focus more on providing differentiated services to customers.

Learn more
